import json
P=[1,3,5,7,9]
# Anchor col -> value for every patterned row; pattern repeats every five columns.
anchors={3:(6,9),4:(4,7),5:(4,9),6:(3,9),7:(3,1),8:(3,3),9:(4,7),10:(4,9),11:(5,3),12:(5,5),13:(5,7),14:(5,9),15:(5,1),16:(5,3),17:(5,5),18:(3,3),19:(3,5),20:(3,7),21:(3,9),22:(3,1),23:(3,3),24:(3,5),25:(3,7),26:(3,9),27:(3,1)}
out=[]
for r in range(28):
    if r==0: row=[1]*28
    elif r==1: row=[1]*28
    elif r==2: row=[1,1]+[4]*26
    else:
        col,val=anchors[r]
        phase=P.index(val)
        row=[1,1,4]+[P[(phase+c-col)%5] for c in range(3,28)]
        if r==3: row[3:6]=[3,2,1]
        elif r==4: row[3]=2
        elif r==5: row[3]=1
    out.append(row)
assert len(out)==28 and all(len(r)==28 for r in out)
print(json.dumps(out,separators=(',',':')))
